description:
Cast Daydream by paying {W}, targeting Returned Pastcaller
Storm-Kiln Artist triggers, creating a Treasure artifact token.
Resolve Daydream, blinking Returned Pastcaller
When Returned Pastcaller enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Daydream to your hand from your graveyard.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {W}.
Repeat.
